Deletes cached physics models (mass center and grab point) of modded items. All data from the cache folder §e"config/inventory-interactions/cache/"§r will be deleted.
The new physics models are calculated the next time you join a world/server. If you are already in a world, the calculation can be started right away, or you can reload resources with §eF3 + T§r.

§lWhen to use:§r
1) It may help to update outdated physics models of modded items.
2) It may help if modded items are held by the wrong point or rotate strangely. If the problem is still there after the recalculation, open an issue on GitHub describing your problem.

In extreme cases you can delete this folder yourself, if for some reason the mod could not do it. After deleting it, a full restart of your client is recommended.
